msg.ae2modularcells.no_component_target: No component slot to install into or replace
ae2modularcells.config.cells.coefficient: The coefficients used by the two formulas. Changing them changes the capacity and rate of every structure.
With C_cap capacity-providing components installed, per-module capacity is multiplied by (1 + b x C_cap).
With C_tr rate-providing components installed, per-module rate is multiplied by (1 + bv x C_tr).
Input cap of the whole structure = total rate x f_in, then clamped by the sum of the per-block input caps.
Every storage component this mod recognises, and what each one contributes. This table is the only source: startup writes the built-in list in here, after that the file is what counts.

One component per line: <item id>=<capacity>:<rate>:<capacity modifier>:<rate modifier>. Change a value to override what it contributes, write 0:0 to disable it, add a line to declare an item outside the built-in list. The last two are written out on save even when unchanged (1.0 = no change), so all four parameters stay visible. Deleting a line only lasts until the next start: the built-in list is written back in.
